name: webhook-design
description: Design inbound + outbound webhooks: event catalog + payload (CloudEvents optional), delivery semantics (at-least-once), retry strategy (exponential backoff + jitter + max attempts + retry-after honored), DLQ, replay + redelivery endpoint, security (HMAC signature + timestamp + replay window, mTLS, rotating secrets, IP allowlist), idempotency on receiver, subscription management API, versioning, rate limiting, observability (delivery log + per-endpoint stats). Mermaid diagrams with optional PNG export.
